[E2E Journey 1] New user: Onboarding → Register → OTP → Home feed loads
[E2E Journey 2] Returning user: Login → Home → Search item → View detail
[E2E Journey 3] Full booking flow: Login → Search → Detail → Book → Confirm
[E2E Journey 4] Item publishing: Login → Add Item Step1 → Step2 → Step3 → Preview → Publish
[E2E Journey 5] Renter contacts owner: Detail → Contact Owner → Chat → Send message
[E2E Journey 6] Post-rental: My Rentals → Completed → Write Review → Submit
[E2E Journey 7] Owner earnings: Login → Profile → Earnings Dashboard → View report
[E2E Journey 8] Booking cancellation: My Rentals → Booking Detail → Cancel → Confirm
[E2E Journey 9] Profile update: Profile → Edit → Update name & photo → Save → Verify
[E2E Journey 10] AI discovery: Home → AI Assistant → Ask about cameras → Tap recommendation
